info.name: Atur Perjalanan API
info.description:
REST API collection for Atur Perjalanan backend (NestJS).

**Milestone coverage:** M3 — Health, Auth, Users | M4 — Trips & Invitations | M5 — Voting | M6 — Activities | M7 — Chat & Media | M8 — Wishlist & Conversion | M9 — Notifications & Background Jobs

## Setup
1. Import this collection and `atur-perjalanan-local.postman_environment.json`
2. Select the **Atur Perjalanan — Local** environment
3. Set `google_id_token` in the environment (from Google Sign-In on mobile/web)
4. Run **Auth → Google Sign-In** — test script saves `access_token` automatically
5. For new users, run **Complete Registration** before other authenticated requests

## Variables
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `base_url` | API base URL (default `http://localhost:8080/v1`) |
| `google_id_token` / `google_id_token_2` | Google OAuth ID token for User 1 / User 2 |
| `access_token` / `access_token_2` | App JWT for User 1 / User 2 (auto-saved after sign-in) |
| `realtime_token` / `realtime_token_2` | Supabase-compatible JWT for Realtime WebSocket (User 1 / User 2) |
| `username` / `username_2` | Username for User 1 / User 2 |
| `trip_id` | Trip UUID — set after Create Trip or copy from List Trips |
| `invitation_id` | Invitation UUID for respond/cancel |
| `poll_id` / `option_id` / `candidate_id` | Voting IDs (copy from List Polls response) |
| `activity_id` | Activity UUID for get/update/delete |
| `member_id` | User UUID of trip member to remove |
| `message_id` | Chat message UUID (auto-saved) |
| `document_id` | Media document UUID (auto-saved from List Documents) |
| `notification_id` | Notification UUID for mark-as-read operations |
| `wishlist_id` | Wishlist UUID for update/delete/convert operations |

item.name: Health
item.description: Infrastructure health check (M2/M3). No authentication required.

request.description:
Returns server health status.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "status": "ok", "timestamp": "2026-07-12T12:00:00.000Z" }
```

Authenticate with Google ID token.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "id_token": "google-oauth-id-token"
}
```

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "access_token": "jwt-token",
  "realtime_token": "supabase-jwt-token",
  "user": {
    "id": "user-uuid",
    "name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "username": "johndoe",
    "avatar_url": null,
    "bio": null,
    "website_url": null,
    "location_label": null,
    "is_public": true
  }
}
```

Complete user registration by setting a username. Required after first Google Sign-In.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "username": "johndoe"
}
```

**Username requirements:**
- 3-30 characters
- Only letters, numbers, and underscores
- No spaces or special characters

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "user": {
    "id": "user-uuid",
    "name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "username": "johndoe",
    "avatar_url": null,
    "bio": null,
    "website_url": null,
    "location_label": null,
    "is_public": true
  }
}
```

**Response 400:** Invalid username format or already taken

item.name: Users
item.description: User profile management and search (M3). Most endpoints require authentication.

request.description:
Check if a username is available (public endpoint). Call this before setting username during registration.

**Query params:**
- `username`: Username to check

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "available": true
}
```

Search for users by name or username using pg_trgm fuzzy matching. Cursor paginated.

**Query params:**
- `q`: Search query (matches name or username)
- `cursor`: Pagination cursor (optional)
- `limit`: Results per page (default: 20, max: 100)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "user-uuid",
      "name": "John Doe",
      "username": "johndoe",
      "avatar_url": "https://...",
      "bio": "Travel enthusiast"
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": "cursor-string"
}
```

Get current user's profile.

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "id": "user-uuid",
  "name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "username": "johndoe",
  "avatar_url": null,
  "bio": null,
  "website_url": null,
  "location_label": null,
  "is_public": true,
  "created_at": "2026-07-01T10:00:00Z"
}
```

Update current user's profile. All fields are optional.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "bio": "Travel enthusiast",
  "website_url": "https://example.com",
  "location_label": "Jakarta, Indonesia",
  "is_public": true
}
```

**Field validations:**
- `bio`: max 150 characters
- `website_url`: must be valid URL
- `location_label`: max 100 characters
- `is_public`: boolean

**Response 200:** Returns updated user profile

Delete current user's account (hard delete). This action cannot be undone.

**Response 204:** No content (account deleted)

**Response 401:** Unauthorized (invalid token)

Get public profile of a user by username. Shows limited info if profile is private.

**URL params:**
- `username`: User's username

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "id": "user-uuid",
  "name": "John Doe",
  "username": "johndoe",
  "avatar_url": "https://...",
  "bio": "Travel enthusiast",
  "website_url": "https://example.com",
  "location_label": "Jakarta, Indonesia",
  "is_public": true
}
```

**Response 404:** User not found

Get public trips of a user. Only shows trips where `is_public = true` unless viewer is the owner.

**URL params:**
- `username`: User's username

**Query params:**
- `cursor`: Pagination cursor (optional)
- `limit`: Results per page (default: 20, max: 100)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "trip-uuid",
      "name": "Bali Adventure",
      "status": "upcoming",
      "start_date": "2026-08-01",
      "end_date": "2026-08-05",
      "cover_image_url": "https://...",
      "participant_count": 4
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": "cursor-string"
}
```

item.name: Trips
item.description: Trip management and invitations (M4). All endpoints require authentication.

request.description:
List user's trips with enriched data (cover, participants, voting status). Cursor paginated.

**Query params:**
- `tab`: Filter by 'upcoming' or 'completed' (default: upcoming)
- `cursor`: Pagination cursor (optional)
- `limit`: Results per page (default: 20, max: 100)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "trip-uuid",
      "name": "Bali Adventure",
      "status": "voting_pending",
      "start_date": "2026-08-01",
      "end_date": "2026-08-05",
      "cover_image_url": "https://...",
      "participant_count": 3,
      "participants_preview": [
        {"id": "user1", "name": "Jane", "avatar_url": "https://..."},
        {"id": "user2", "name": "Bob", "avatar_url": "https://..."}
      ],
      "voting_deadline": "2026-07-25T23:59:59Z"
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": "cursor-string"
}
```

Create a new trip. Can be created in fixed-date mode or voting mode.

**Request body (Fixed date mode):**
```json
{
  "name": "Bali Adventure 2026",
  "tags": ["beach", "adventure"],
  "start_date": "2026-08-01",
  "end_date": "2026-08-05",
  "is_all_day": true,
  "start_time": "09:00",
  "end_time": "18:00"
}
```

**Request body (Voting mode):**
```json
{
  "name": "Bali Adventure 2026",
  "tags": ["beach", "adventure"],
  "candidates": [
    {"start_date": "2026-08-01", "end_date": "2026-08-05"},
    {"start_date": "2026-08-08", "end_date": "2026-08-12"}
  ],
  "voting_deadline": "2026-07-25T23:59:59Z"
}
```

**Response 201:** Returns created trip with `status: fixed` or `status: voting_pending`

Get detailed information about a specific trip.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "id": "trip-uuid",
  "name": "Bali Adventure",
  "status": "voting_pending",
  "start_date": "2026-08-01",
  "end_date": "2026-08-05",
  "is_all_day": true,
  "start_time": "09:00",
  "end_time": "18:00",
  "tags": ["beach", "adventure"],
  "cover_image_url": "https://...",
  "creator_id": "user-uuid",
  "created_at": "2026-07-15T10:00:00Z",
  "participants": [
    {
      "id": "user-uuid",
      "name": "John Doe",
      "username": "johndoe",
      "avatar_url": "https://...",
      "role": "creator"
    }
  ],
  "voting_deadline": "2026-07-25T23:59:59Z"
}
```

Update trip details. Only trip creator can update.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Request body (all fields optional):**
```json
{
  "name": "Updated Trip Name",
  "tags": ["updated", "tags"],
  "start_date": "2026-08-02",
  "end_date": "2026-08-06",
  "is_all_day": false,
  "start_time": "10:00",
  "end_time": "20:00"
}
```

**Response 200:** Returns updated trip

**Response 403:** Forbidden (not creator)

**Response 404:** Trip not found

Soft delete a trip. Only trip creator can delete. Sets `deleted_at` timestamp.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Response 204:** No content (trip soft-deleted)

**Response 403:** Forbidden (not creator)

**Response 404:** Trip not found or already deleted

**Response 200:** Returns updated trip with `cover_image_url`

Remove a member from a trip. Only trip creator can remove members.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `memberId`: User UUID of member to remove

**Response 204:** No content (member removed)

**Response 403:** Forbidden (not creator)

**Response 404:** Trip or member not found

List current user's pending trip invitations.

**Query params:**
- `cursor`: Pagination cursor (optional)
- `limit`: Results per page (default: 20, max: 100)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "invitation-uuid",
      "trip": {
        "id": "trip-uuid",
        "name": "Bali Adventure",
        "status": "voting_pending",
        "start_date": "2026-08-01",
        "end_date": "2026-08-05",
        "cover_image_url": "https://..."
      },
      "inviter": {
        "id": "user-uuid",
        "name": "John Doe",
        "username": "johndoe",
        "avatar_url": "https://..."
      },
      "status": "pending",
      "created_at": "2026-07-15T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": "cursor-string"
}
```

Invite a user to a trip via username or email. Only trip participants can invite.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Request body (via username):**
```json
{
  "username": "janedoe"
}
```

**Request body (via email):**
```json
{
  "email": "jane@example.com"
}
```

**Response 201:** Returns created invitation with enriched trip and inviter data

**Response 400:** Invalid input or user already invited/participant

**Response 404:** User or trip not found

Accept or decline a trip invitation. Only the invited user can respond.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `invitationId`: Invitation UUID

**Request body (accept):**
```json
{
  "accept": true
}
```

**Request body (decline):**
```json
{
  "accept": false
}
```

**Response 204:** No content (invitation responded)
- If accept=true: User added as trip participant, invitation deleted
- If accept=false: Invitation marked as declined, deleted

**Response 404:** Invitation not found or already responded

Cancel a pending invitation. Only the inviter can cancel their own invitations.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `invitationId`: Invitation UUID

**Response 204:** No content (invitation cancelled)

**Response 403:** Forbidden (not the inviter)

**Response 404:** Invitation not found or already responded

item.name: Voting
item.description: Voting system for trips (M5). Supports date candidates and activity/other polls.

request.description:
Create a new poll (activities or other). Max 1 active poll per type.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "poll_type": "aktivitas",
  "title": "Activity Preferences",
  "options": [
    {"label": "Surfing lessons"},
    {"label": "Temple tours"},
    {"label": "Beach relaxation"}
  ]
}
```

**Poll types:**
- `aktivitas`: Activity preferences
- `lainnya`: Custom/other polls
- Note: `tanggal` polls are auto-created with date candidates, do not create manually

**Response 201:** Returns created poll with options

**Response 400:** Invalid input or active poll already exists for this type

Vote on a poll option. Only trip participants can vote. Overwrites previous vote.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `pollId`: Poll UUID

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "option_id": "option-uuid"
}
```

**Response 204:** No content (vote recorded)

**Response 400:** Poll not active or invalid option

**Response 404:** Poll or option not found

Retract (remove) your vote from a poll.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `pollId`: Poll UUID

**Response 204:** No content (vote retracted)

**Response 404:** Poll not found

Vote on a date candidate for the trip. Only trip participants can vote. Overwrites previous vote.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `candidateId`: Date candidate UUID

**Response 204:** No content (vote recorded)

**Response 400:** Voting deadline passed or trip status changed

**Response 404:** Candidate or trip not found

Retract (remove) your vote from a date candidate.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `candidateId`: Date candidate UUID

**Response 204:** No content (vote retracted)

**Response 404:** Candidate or trip not found

Lock a poll and set the winning option. Only trip creator can lock polls.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `pollId`: Poll UUID

**For date polls (poll_type=tanggal):**
- Sets `trips.start_date` and `trips.end_date` to winning candidate
- Updates `trips.status` to `fixed`
- Clears `trips.voting_deadline`

**For other polls:**
- Marks poll as `status: locked`
- Stores winning option

**Response 204:** No content (poll locked)

**Response 400:** Poll already locked or no votes yet

**Response 403:** Forbidden (not creator)

**Response 404:** Poll not found

Delete a poll. Only trip creator can delete active polls.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `pollId`: Poll UUID

**Response 204:** No content (poll deleted)

**Response 403:** Forbidden (not creator)

**Response 404:** Poll not found

item.name: Activities
item.description: Trip itinerary activities (M6). CRUD operations for trip activities.

request.description:
List all activities for a trip, grouped/sorted by date and time.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Response 200:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": "activity-uuid",
    "trip_id": "trip-uuid",
    "activity_date": "2026-08-01",
    "start_time": "09:00",
    "end_time": "12:00",
    "kind": "destination",
    "title": "Visit Uluwatu Temple",
    "description": "Famous cliffside temple",
    "location_label": "Uluwatu, Bali",
    "maps_link": "https://maps.google.com/...",
    "ref_links": ["https://example.com/tickets"],
    "cover_source": "maps",
    "cover_icon": "temple",
    "cover_document_id": "doc-uuid",
    "thumbnail_url": "https://maps.googleapis.com/...",
    "created_at": "2026-07-15T10:00:00Z"
  }
]
```

Get a single activity by ID.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `activityId`: Activity UUID

**Response 200:** Returns activity object with full details

**Response 404:** Activity not found

body.raw:
{
  "activity_date": "2026-08-01",
  "start_time": "09:00",
  "end_time": "12:00",
  "kind": "destination",
  "title": "Visit Uluwatu Temple",
  "description": "Famous cliffside temple with sunset views",
  "location_label": "Uluwatu, Bali",
  "maps_link": "https://maps.google.com/?q=uluwatu+temple",
  "ref_links": ["https://example.com/tickets"],
  "cover_source": "document",
  "cover_document_id": "{{document_id}}"
}

request.description:
Create a new trip activity. Any trip participant can create activities.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "activity_date": "2026-08-01",
  "start_time": "09:00",
  "end_time": "12:00",
  "kind": "destination",
  "title": "Visit Uluwatu Temple",
  "description": "Famous cliffside temple",
  "location_label": "Uluwatu, Bali",
  "maps_link": "https://maps.google.com/...",
  "ref_links": ["https://example.com/tickets"],
  "cover_source": "document",
  "cover_document_id": "doc-uuid"
}
```

**Activity kinds:**
- `destination`: Main attractions/activities
- `logistics`: Transport, check-in, etc.
- `food`: Meals and dining
- `rest`: Free time/breaks

**Cover sources:**
- `document`: Use trip document image
- `icon`: Use built-in icon
- `google`: Auto-resolve from maps_link

**Response 201:** Returns created activity

**Response 400:** Invalid date (outside trip date range for fixed trips)

Update an existing activity. Any trip participant can update activities.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `activityId`: Activity UUID

**Request body (all fields optional):**
```json
{
  "activity_date": "2026-08-02",
  "start_time": "10:00",
  "end_time": "13:00",
  "kind": "logistics",
  "title": "Updated Activity",
  "description": "Updated description",
  "location_label": "New Location",
  "maps_link": "https://maps.google.com/...",
  "ref_links": ["https://example.com/new-link"],
  "cover_source": "icon",
  "cover_icon": "restaurant"
}
```

**Response 200:** Returns updated activity

**Response 404:** Activity not found

Delete an activity. Any trip participant can delete activities.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `activityId`: Activity UUID

**Response 204:** No content (activity deleted)

**Response 404:** Activity not found

item.name: Chat
item.description: Trip chat messaging (M7). Real-time chat with Supabase Realtime.

request.description:
List messages in a trip chat. Cursor paginated by created_at (most recent first).

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Query params:**
- `cursor`: Pagination cursor (optional)
- `limit`: Messages per page (default: 20, max: 100)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "message-uuid",
      "trip_id": "trip-uuid",
      "sender_id": "user-uuid",
      "sender": {
        "id": "user-uuid",
        "name": "John Doe",
        "username": "johndoe",
        "avatar_url": "https://..."
      },
      "message_kind": "text",
      "message_text": "Hey everyone, excited for the trip!",
      "media_url": null,
      "reply_to_id": "parent-message-uuid",
      "reply_to": {
        "id": "parent-message-uuid",
        "message_text": "Original message",
        "sender": {"name": "Jane", "username": "jane"}
      },
      "created_at": "2026-07-15T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": "2026-07-15T09:30:00Z"
}
```

Send a message in trip chat. Only trip participants can send messages.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Request body (text message):**
```json
{
  "message_kind": "text",
  "message_text": "Hey everyone!"
}
```

**Request body (media message):**
```json
{
  "message_kind": "photo",
  "media_url": "https://r2-presigned-url/file.jpg"
}
```

**Request body (with reply):**
```json
{
  "message_kind": "text",
  "message_text": "I agree!",
  "reply_to_id": "parent-message-uuid"
}
```

**Message kinds:**
- `text`: Plain text message
- `photo`: Image/video
- `video`: Video file

**Response 201:** Returns created message with enriched sender data

**Response 400:** Invalid input or not a trip participant

Mark all messages in the trip as read for the current user. Updates `trip_message_reads.last_read_at` timestamp.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Response 204:** No content (messages marked as read)

**Response 404:** Trip not found or user not a participant

Soft delete a message. Only the sender can delete their own messages.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `messageId`: Message UUID

**Response 204:** No content (message soft-deleted)

**Response 403:** Forbidden (not the sender)

**Response 404:** Message not found or already deleted

item.name: Media
item.description: Trip media/documents management (M7). Register and manage uploaded files.

request.description:
List all documents (media files) registered for a trip.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Response 200:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": "document-uuid",
    "trip_id": "trip-uuid",
    "uploader_id": "user-uuid",
    "filename": "sunset.jpg",
    "media_type": "image",
    "content_type": "image/jpeg",
    "storage_key": "trips/trip-uuid/user-uuid/file.jpg",
    "size_bytes": 2048576,
    "from_chat": false,
    "presigned_url": "https://r2-presigned-url/file.jpg",
    "created_at": "2026-07-15T10:00:00Z"
  }
]
```

**Note:** `presigned_url` is a 1-hour presigned GET URL for direct download

Register an uploaded R2 object as a trip document. Use after presigned upload.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "filename": "sunset.jpg",
  "storage_key": "trips/trip-uuid/user-uuid/file.jpg",
  "media_type": "image",
  "content_type": "image/jpeg",
  "size_bytes": 2048576,
  "from_chat": false
}
```

**Media types:**
- `image`: Photo/image files
- `video`: Video files

**Note:** `storage_key` must match the key used in the presigned upload.

**Response 201:** Returns registered document with presigned download URL

**Response 400:** Invalid input or R2 object verification failed

Delete a document from R2 and remove database record. Only uploader or trip creator can delete.

**URL params:**
- `tripId`: Trip UUID
- `documentId`: Document UUID

**Response 204:** No content (document deleted from R2 and database)

**Response 403:** Forbidden (not uploader or creator)

**Response 404:** Document not found

item.name: Uploads
item.description: R2 presigned upload flow (M7). Get presigned URLs for direct upload to Cloudflare R2.

request.description:
Get a presigned PUT URL for direct upload to Cloudflare R2. Valid for 5 minutes.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "trip_id": "trip-uuid",
  "media_type": "image",
  "content_type": "image/jpeg",
  "filename": "sunset.jpg"
}
```

**Media types:**
- `image`: Photo/image files
- `video`: Video files

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "upload_url": "https://r2-url/...?X-Amz-...",
  "storage_key": "trips/trip-uuid/user-uuid/20260715-120000-sunset.jpg",
  "expires_in": 300
}
```

**Upload Flow:**
1. Call this endpoint to get presigned PUT URL
2. PUT file directly to R2 using the returned `upload_url`
3. Call `POST /trips/:tripId/documents` to register the uploaded file

**Response 400:** Invalid input or not a trip participant

Convert a wishlist item into a trip with seeded activities. Atomic transaction.

**URL params:**
- `id`: Wishlist UUID

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "trip_name": "Bali Surfing Adventure",
  "start_date": "2026-09-01",
  "end_date": "2026-09-05",
  "tags": ["surfing", "adventure"]
}
```

**Transaction flow:**
1. Creates trip with `status: fixed`
2. Seeds day 1 activities from wishlist data
3. Soft deletes the wishlist item
4. Returns trip + created activities
5. Rollbacks on any failure

**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "trip": {
    "id": "trip-uuid",
    "name": "Bali Surfing Adventure",
    "status": "fixed",
    "start_date": "2026-09-01",
    "end_date": "2026-09-05",
    "tags": ["surfing", "adventure"],
    ...
  },
  "activities": [
    {
      "id": "activity-uuid",
      "title": "Surfing lessons in Uluwatu",
      "activity_date": "2026-09-01",
      "start_time": "09:00",
      "end_time": "12:00",
      ...
    }
  ]
}
```

**Response 404:** Wishlist not found

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Notification management and real-time updates (M9). All endpoints require authentication.

query.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100)

request.description:
Get current user's notifications with enriched actor/trip data. Cursor paginated by `created_at` timestamp.

**Query params:**
- `cursor` (optional): RFC3339 timestamp for pagination
- `limit` (optional): Items per page (default: 20, max: 100)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "notif-uuid",
      "type": "invite",
      "actor": {
        "id": "user-uuid",
        "name": "Jane Doe",
        "username": "janedoe",
        "avatar_url": "https://..."
      },
      "trip": {
        "id": "trip-uuid",
        "name": "Bali Trip",
        "status": "voting_pending",
        "start_date": "2026-08-01",
        "end_date": "2026-08-05"
      },
      "payload": { "invitation_id": "inv-uuid" },
      "is_read": false,
      "created_at": "2026-07-19T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": "2026-07-19T09:30:00Z"
}
```

**Notification types:**
- `invite`: Trip invitation received
- `follow`: User followed you (post-MVP)
- `voting_deadline`: Voting deadline reminder (H-7d, H-1d, H-1h)
- `activity_update`: Activity created or modified
